armySpecialRules.name: ELVEN GRACE
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule have the Dodge (6+) special rule in close combat. However, this cannot be used against enemies that attack before the model with Elven Grace.

armySpecialRules.name: ETERNAL HATRED
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule have the Hatred special rule in addition to Hatred (High Elves).

armySpecialRules.name: HEKARTI'S BLESSING
armySpecialRules.description: A Wizard with this special rule gains a +1 casting bonus.

armySpecialRules.name: MURDEROUS PROWESS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule may re-roll all To Wound rolls of 1 when making close combat attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: KHAINITE
armySpecialRules.description: Models who are Khainites (except models deploying using the Hidden special rule) may only join units which are also Khainites, and models who are not Khainites may not join Khainite units.

armySpecialRules.name: SEA DRAGON CLOAK
armySpecialRules.description: A Sea Dragon Cloak gives the wearer the Natural Armour (5+) special rule against missile attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: DEATHRAIN CROSSBOW
armySpecialRules.description:
Deathrain crossbows have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
16/24" | 2 | Multiple Shots (3), Rapid Fire

armySpecialRules.name: REPEATER HANDBOW
armySpecialRules.description:
Repeater handbows have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
8/12" | 2 | Multiple Shots (3), Quick Shot, Rapid Fire

magicItems.name: DOOMSINGER
magicItems.description: At the beginning of each round of close combat, roll a D3; the result is the number you may increase the wielder's Weapon Skill, Strength and Attacks by.

magicItems.name: CHILLBLADE
magicItems.description: Attacks made with the Chillblade wound automatically and have the Ice Attacks special rule. For each unsaved Wound suffered from the Chillblade, the target suffers -1 to its Attacks characteristic until the end of this Close Combat phase.

magicItems.name: VENOMFANG BLADE
magicItems.description: Any model that suffers an unsaved Wound from this weapon must pass a Toughness test on a 2D6 or automatically lose all remaining wounds.

magicItems.name: EXECUTIONER'S AXE
magicItems.description: In close combat, the wielder of the Executioner's Axe counts as having a Strength value equal to double that of their target's Toughness. In addition, any attacks made with the Executioner's Axe have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. Furthermore, the wielder gains the Khainite special rule.

magicItems.name: BLOOD BLADES
magicItems.description: These weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength and the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: SHADE CLAW
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Ignores Armour saves special rule. In addition, no Parry saves may be taken against it.

magicItems.name: DRAICH OF DARK POWER
magicItems.description: The wielder of the Draich of Dark Power ignores the normal Initiative penalties from great weapons as well as gaining the Khainite and Killing Blow special rules.

magicItems.name: LIFETAKER
magicItems.description:
Lifetaker fires using the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
30" | 4 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (3)
Lifetaker ignores all To Hit modifiers.

magicItems.name: WEB OF SHADOWS
magicItems.description: The model can choose to use the Web of Shadows in addition to their normal attacks. When used, one model in base contact with the character automatically takes 2D6 Strength 3 hits.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF SPITE
magicItems.description: Any To Hit roll of 5+ with the Blade of Spite automatically Wounds. Armour saves apply as normal. This has no effect on models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

magicItems.name: CRONE BLADE
magicItems.description: Roll a D6 each time the wielder of this weapon (excluding mounts) causes an unsaved Wound in close combat. On the roll of a 4+, they regain 1 Wound suffered earlier during the game.

magicItems.name: DEATHPIERCER
magicItems.description: Attacks made with Deathpiercer have the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: SHADESLIVER
magicItems.description: After every round of close combat in which the bearer of this item inflicts one or more Unsaved Wounds, this weapon gains +1 Strength for the remainder of the battle. This effect is cumulative.

magicItems.name: THE MIRROR GLAIVE
magicItems.description: Each time an enemy spell cast at the bearer of this weapon or the unit they are with is dispelled, you may attempt to cast the same spell back as if it was a Bound Spell, using your Dispel dice as if they were Power dice. The enemy may then attempt to dispel it using their Power dice.

magicItems.name: SHADRACAR'S FANG
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 To Hit and the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: SOULRENDER
magicItems.description: Attacks made with Soulrender have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. In addition, the wielder gains the Khainite special rule.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF RUIN
magicItems.description: Attacks made with the Sword of Ruin have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: CALEDOR'S BANE
magicItems.description: Caledor's Bane gives the wielder the Devastating Charge special rule, and attacks made with it ignore Natural Armour.

magicItems.name: HEARTSEEKER
magicItems.description: The model wielding Heartseeker may re-roll all failed rolls To Hit and To Wound in close combat.

magicItems.name: HYDRA BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder of the Hydra Blade has the Random Attacks (D6) special rule in addition to their normal attacks.

magicItems.name: DAGGER OF HOTEK
magicItems.description: The Dagger of Hotek gives the wielder the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF ETERNAL SERVITUDE
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Armour of Eternal Servitude gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF LIVING DEATH
magicItems.description: The wearer gains +1 Toughness and +1 Wound. However, they also become subject to Stupidity.

magicItems.name: BLOOD ARMOUR
magicItems.description: For every unsaved wound the wearer of the Blood Armour inflicts in close combat, their armour save is improved by one point to a maximum total of 2+ for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF DARKNESS
magicItems.description: The Armour of Darkness gives the wearer a 3+ armour save and the Immunity (Armour Piercing) special rule.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF HAG GRAEF
magicItems.description: Any missile attack on a model wearing the Cloak of Hag Graef has its Strength halved (rounding up) before rolling To Wound.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF GHROND
magicItems.description: The Shield of Ghrond causes all Hits on the model to be resolved with -1 Strength.

magicItems.name: THE BLACK AMULET
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Black Amulet has the Magical Ward (4+) special rule. In addition, each time the bearer of the Black Amulet makes a successful Magical Ward save in close combat, the Black Amulet inflicts one Wound which Ignores Armour saves on the opponent that struck the blow.

magicItems.name: RING OF HOTEK
magicItems.description: The bearer and any unit they join have the Magic Resistance (3) special rule. Any enemy Wizard that attempts to cast or target a spell on a unit within 12" of the bearer will suffer a miscast on a roll of double 6, as well as double 1.

magicItems.name: PENDANT OF KHAELETH
magicItems.description: Roll a D6 for every wound suffered by the wearer; on a roll lower than the Strength of the Attack, the Wound is ignored. Rolls of 6 always fail.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF BLACK IRON
magicItems.description: The Crown of Black Iron gives the bearer +1 Leadership as well as the Magical Ward (5+) and Magic Resistance (1) special rules.

magicItems.name: RING OF DARKNESS
magicItems.description: The Ring of Darkness causes all close combat attacks directed against the bearer to be resolved at half their normal Weapon Skill (rounding up). Any missile attacks directed at the model or their unit resolved at half their normal Ballistic Skill (rounding up).

magicItems.name: HEART-STONE OF DARKNESS
magicItems.description: The Heart-stone of Darkness gives the bearer the Magical Ward (4+) special rule against close combat attacks.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF TWILIGHT
magicItems.description: Enemy units cannot charge or target the bearer with missile attacks or spells if they are more than 12" away from them. Within 12", they can only be charged or targeted by first rolling a 4+ on a D6. If the test is failed, the unit may choose a new target as normal.

magicItems.name: SHADOWSHROUD RING
magicItems.description: This ring may be used at the start of any of your turns. Until the start of your next turn, no enemy units can declare a charge or target the unit with spells or missile attacks unless they are within 6" of the bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: SEAL OF GHROND
magicItems.description: The Seal of Ghrond adds +1 Dispel dice to your dispel pool at the start of every enemy Magic phase.

magicItems.name: AMBER AMULET
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Amber Amulet gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: INCORPOREAL RETAINER
magicItems.description: All enemy models attacking the bearer of this item must re-roll successful rolls To Hit.

magicItems.name: CHARM OF HOTEK
magicItems.description: The model wearing the Charm of Hotek gains a 6+ Armour Save and the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: NULL TALISMAN
magicItems.description: Any dispel attempt made against enemy spells targeting the model carrying this item, or any unit they are with, gains a +3 dispel bonus.

magicItems.name: BLACK STAFF
magicItems.description: Whenever the bearer casts a spell, they may add an additional free power dice to the result after rolling the dice. However, if this extra dice rolls a 1, the Wizard suffers 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: SHADOW STONE
magicItems.description: When casting spells from the Lore of Shadow, the Wizard gains a +1 casting bonus and may re-roll a single roll of a natural 1 per casting attempt.

magicItems.name: DARKSTAR CLOAK
magicItems.description: The Darkstar Cloak gives the Wizard +D3 Power dice in each of your Magic phases. Only they may use these extra dice.

magicItems.name: THE SACRIFICIAL DAGGER
magicItems.description: Once per casting attempt, after the casting dice are rolled but before a dispel attempt is made, the bearer of this magic item can sacrifice one model in her unit. Choose which model is sacrificed – it is immediately removed as a casualty with no saves of any kind allowed – then roll a D6. On a 2+, the Sorceress gains an extra power dice that must be rolled and added to the casting result; dispel attempts can now be made and the spell resolved. This can be used to allow the Wizard to use more dice than is normally allowed by their Wizard level. On a roll of a 1, the sacrifice has not generated enough power – you can either immediately sacrifice another model from the unit and roll again, following the procedure above, or accept the original casting result (if the bearer is the only model remaining in the unit, no further sacrifices can be attempted).

magicItems.name: SOULSTONE
magicItems.description: The Soulstone makes the Sorceress immune to the effects of her first Miscast.

magicItems.name: FOCUS FAMILIAR
magicItems.description: The Focus Familiar allows the wielder to cast spells from a different position on the battlefield. Place a marker no more than 1" in diameter at the start of each Dark Elf Magic phase within 6" of the Wizard and at least 1" away from units or impassable terrain. They may use this position when determining range and line of sight (at 360°) for their spells for remainder of each Magic phase.

magicItems.name: THE GEM OF SPITE
magicItems.description: Whenever the bearer suffers a miscast, the Gem of Spite inflicts a single Strength 6 hit on every enemy Wizard within 18".

magicItems.name: ORB OF GHROND
magicItems.description: The model carrying the Orb of Ghrond may consult it at the start of each of your turns as long as they are not in close combat. If they do so, they become subject to the Stupidity special rule for the remainder of the turn. However, the model may also re- roll one power or dispel dice when casting or dispelling until the start of your next turn.

magicItems.name: TOME OF FURION
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Tome of Furion gains the Loremaster (Lore of Dark Magic) special rule.

magicItems.name: WAND OF THE KHARAIDON
magicItems.description: When casting the Doombolt spell from the Lore of Dark Magic, you may re-roll the number of Hits caused.

magicItems.name: ANKLET OF EPIPHANY
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains +6" to the range of their spells (except auras) if they are within 6" of a terrain feature.

magicItems.name: CRYSTAL HEART
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may choose to attempt to cast one spell twice per Magic phase. However, every time they choose to do so, roll a D6 first. On the roll of a 1, the model suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: RUBRIC OF DARK DIMENSIONS
magicItems.description: The Rubric of Dark Dimensions contains a direct damage spell which targets all enemy models in base contact with the caster. The target models must pass a Strength test for each Wound on their profile or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: ASPHYXICA CENSER
magicItems.description: At the start of each round of close combat, all enemy models in base contact with the bearer must take a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF WOE
magicItems.description: Enemy units cannot use the Inspiring Presence special rule while they are within 6" of the bearer of this item. After the bearer has slain one or more models in close combat, the range is increased to 12" for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: DECANTER OF EGOS
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 6" of the bearer gain +1 to their Movement characteristic.

magicItems.name: PEARL OF INFINITE BLEAKNESS
magicItems.description: The model bearing the Pearl of Infinite Bleakness and any unit they are with gain the Immunity (Psychology) special rule. In addition, any enemy unit in base contact with the bearer suffers -1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: BLACK DRAGON EGG
magicItems.description: The bearer may consume this item at the start of any player turn. For the rest of that turn, the consumer has Strength and Toughness 6, and the Noxious Breath (see Black Dragons) special rule.

magicItems.name: DEATHMASK
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Deathmask causes Terror.

magicItems.name: THE HYDRA'S TEETH
magicItems.description: The Hydra's Teeth can be used at the start of any close combat phase. Once used, they inflict 5D6 Weapon Skill 2, Strength 3 Attacks on one enemy unit in base contact.

magicItems.name: THE GUIDING EYE
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Guiding Eye and any unit they are with may re-roll 1's To Hit with missile weapons.

magicItems.name: CRYSTAL OF MIDNIGHT
magicItems.description: Nominate one enemy Wizard within 12" at the start of any of their Magic phases. The Wizard must pass a Leadership test or lose one randomly determined spell for the rest of the battle.

magicItems.name: THE CLOAK OF DARK SOULS
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Cloak of Dark Souls gains the Hidden and Scouts special rules.

magicItems.name: GEM OF NIGHTMARES
magicItems.description: The Gem of Nightmares can be used at the start of any turn. Until the end of that turn, the model and any unit it is with has the Terror special rule.

magicItems.name: SEVENFOLD SHADOW
magicItems.description: Instead of moving normally in the Remaining Moves sub-phase, the model may be moved to anywhere on the battlefield, as long as they do not end their move within 6" of any enemy unit or 1" of impassable terrain.

magicItems.name: SEA SERPENT STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: SACRIFICIAL BANNER
magicItems.description: All enemy Monstrous Creatures or Monsters with Line of Sight to the unit carrying this standard gain the Berserk Rage portion of the Frenzy special rule against it. In addition, they suffer a -3 Leadership modifier for any Berserk Rage tests against the unit bearing this standard.

magicItems.name: DREAD BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Fear special rule.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF SLAUGHTER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +D3 to their combat resolution bonus on any turn the unit charges.

magicItems.name: SOUL SHADOWS STANDARD
magicItems.description: If the unit carrying this standard chooses Flee as a charge reaction it automatically rallies at the end of their Flee move (as long as the charging unit does not reach it).

magicItems.name: TRAITOR'S BANNER
magicItems.description: Enemy units attempting to target the unit carrying this standard with missile attacks or spells must pass a Leadership test. If failed, they must choose another target. If no other target is available, they cannot choose to cast that spell this turn.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF NAGARYTHE
magicItems.description: All friendly units of Dark Elves within 12" of this standard gain the Eternal Hatred special rule.

magicItems.name: HYDRA BANNER
magicItems.description: All models in the unit carrying this standard gain +1 Attack in the first round of any close combat.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF HAG GRAEF
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Always Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF HAR GANETH
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard causes Terror.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF COLD BLOOD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Cold-Blooded special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF MURDER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard adds an additional D6" to their charge range.

magicItems.name: THE BLOOD BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this banner are not subject to Stupidity caused by Cold Ones.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF DARK MAGIC
loresOfMagic.attribute: When a Wizard successfully casts a hex, magic missile or direct damage spell from this lore, and the casting roll contains any double, the spell's target unit suffers 2D6 Strength 2 hits after the spell has been resolved. If the casting roll contains any treble, the spell's target unit instead suffers 3D6 hits instead.

spells.name: DOOMBOLT OF KHARAIDON
spells.description: Doombolt of Kharaidon is a magic missile with a range of 18" that causes D6 Strength 5 hits.

spells.name: DEATH SPASM
spells.description: Death Spasm is a direct damage spell with a range of 18" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). The target must take D3 Toughness tests. Each failed Toughness test causes a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. In addition, all models in base contact with the target suffer a Hit at the target's base Strength.

spells.name: NAGAELYTHE THE CHILLWIND
spells.description: Nagaelythe the Chillwind is a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 2 hits. If the target suffers any unsaved Wounds, all models in the unit suffer a -1 penalty to their Ballistic Skill characteristic until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: SHADOW DAGGERS
spells.description: Shadow Daggers is a magic missile with a range of 12" that causes D6 Strength 3 Hits with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule on all enemy units in the caster's front arc.

spells.name: SAP STRENGTH
spells.description: Sap Strength is a hex spell with a range of 24". All models in the target unit suffer -1 to their Strength (to a minimum of 1) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: BLADEWIND
spells.description: Bladewind is a direct damage area spell with a range of 18" that uses the large round template. All models hit by the template must pass a Weapon Skill test or suffer a Strength 4 hit.

spells.name: POWER OF DARKNESS
spells.description: Power of Darkness is an augment spell with a range of 18". All models in the target unit gain +1 Strength until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. In addition, add D3 power dice to your power pool. If a natural 6 is rolled when generating these power dice, the caster suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

spells.name: TENEBRAEL BLADES
spells.description: Tenebrael Blades is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Armour Piercing (2) and Magical Attacks special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: CHROESH – WORD OF PAIN
spells.description: Chroesh – Word of Pain is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit gains the Always Strikes Last special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: SHROUD OF DESPAIR
spells.description: Remains in play. Shroud of Despair is a hex aura with a range of 12". While the spell is in effect, the affected units cannot benefit from the Hold Your Ground or Inspiring Presence special rules. In addition, whenever an affected unit fails a Break, Panic or Terror test, all target units suffer -1 to their Leadership (this effect is cumulative).

spells.name: OBLIVION
spells.description: Oblivion is a direct damage aura spell with a range of 6". Each model (friend and foe, except the caster) within range (even if they are engaged in close combat) suffers a Strength 5 Hit.

spells.name: ANCHAN-ROGAR THE SOUL STEALER
spells.description: Anchan-Rogar the Soul Stealer is a direct damage spell with a range of 24". All models in the unit suffer a Wound on the roll of a 5+ which Ignores Armour Saves. Roll a D6 for each unsaved Wound inflicted by this spell. For each roll of 5+, the caster immediately gains a single Wound (to a maximum of 10).

spells.name: ARNZIPAL'S BLACK HORROR
spells.description: Remains in play. Arnzipal's Black Horror is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move must pass a Strength test per Wound on their profile or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves and Regeneration.

gifts_of_khaine.name: DANCE OF DOOM
gifts_of_khaine.description: Enemies targeting the model must re-roll all successful To Hit rolls with missile weapons and in close combat.

gifts_of_khaine.name: CRY OF WAR
gifts_of_khaine.description: All enemy units in base contact with the wearer suffer -1 To Hit in the first round of close combat.

gifts_of_khaine.name: RENDING STARS
gifts_of_khaine.description:
Rending Stars are missile weapons with the following profile.
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
6/9" | As user +1 | Multiple Shots (3), Quick Shot

gifts_of_khaine.name: WITCHBREW
gifts_of_khaine.description: This model, and all models in the same unit, gain the Frenzy special rule and can never lose their Frenzy.

gifts_of_khaine.name: BLACK LOTUS
gifts_of_khaine.description: Each unsaved Wound caused in Close Combat counts as two for the purpose of combat resolution. This has no effect against models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

gifts_of_khaine.name: HAND OF KHAINE
gifts_of_khaine.description: All enemy units in base contact suffer a -1 penalty to their Weapon Skill and Initiative.

gifts_of_khaine.name: RUNE OF KHAINE
gifts_of_khaine.description: The model gains the Random Attacks (D3) special rule in addition to its normal attacks.

gifts_of_khaine.name: BLOOD SIGIL
gifts_of_khaine.description: The model may re-roll failed Leadership tests when using Blood Rites. However, if they roll any doubles on the second roll, they will suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

gifts_of_khaine.name: DARK VENOM
gifts_of_khaine.description: A model with Dark Venom gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule (including missile attacks). This has no effect against models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

gifts_of_khaine.name: MANBANE
gifts_of_khaine.description: A model with Manbane will automatically Wound on the roll of a 2+ (including missile attacks). This has no effect against models with Immunity (Poisoned Attacks).

gifts_of_khaine.name: TOUCH OF DEATH
gifts_of_khaine.description: The model gains the Killing Blow special rule.

gifts_of_khaine.name: KHAINITE PENDANT
gifts_of_khaine.description: The model may attempt to use two Blood Rites this turn.
